data.title: Defense Minister Katz threatens to seize Lebanese land if Hezbollah, Iran attack | The Jerusalem Post
data.description: “If Hezbollah joins Iran in an attack on Israel, it will be dealt a heavy blow and lose additional territory in southern Lebanon, in the areas of Nabatieh and Litani," said the defense minister.
